summary: This video breaks down the monthly Crimson Crow's Feast event and its associated Banquet Overture battle pass. The event runs from the 1st to the 11th of each month, followed by an announcement window ending on the 13th when Gold-Leaf Invitation rewards are revealed. Players collect Silver-Plated Invitations through pass milestones or shop purchases, with a chance to pull server-limited Gold-Leaf Invitations. Gold-Leaf Invitations guarantee either a Sagomir figurine, a Rare-Legendary Hero Option Chest, or a random Legendary hero. The host also evaluates the event's paid track and store bundle offerings.
tips: Crimson Crow's Feast runs from day 1 to day 11 each month, with final Gold-Leaf results opening on day 13.
The free Banquet Overture pass track grants 4 Silver-Plated Invitations at 10, 100, 200, and 300 Banquet Notes.
Purchasing the premium Banquet Overture pass unlocks 20 additional Silver-Plated Invitations across the reward milestones.
Because Gold-Leaf Invitations have a limited server-wide allocation, open your invitations promptly during the active period before the quota runs out.
Gold-Leaf Invitations award either a Sagomir figurine, a Rare-Legendary Hero Option Chest, or a random Legendary hero.
